description: SportWizzard's edge finder: DFS/book offers that are +EV versus the devigged fair market, with the edge %, the book(s) setting fair value, and per-book odds. Filter by league, source (DFS/book), minimum edge, or a single event. Paginate with cursor. GAME markets only: season and tournament futures are excluded by design — they never enter de-vig or edge math, so an empty result here says nothing about futures coverage (query those with get_odds scope=season).

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor. Pass the `nextCursor` from a previous response to fetch the next page.

event_id.description: Scope to a single event UUID.

limit.description: Max rows to return (page size). Default 50, server caps apply.

source.description: DFS/book source id to find edges for (e.g. prizepicks, underdog).

name: get_edges
